purpose: Teach: 借地/集成/私有/兼業/満了/抹消/協約/家主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、借地から本社を始められたぞ
lines.en: Your father built the company from a rented space when we started, you know.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the memory. Measured pace. Eyes distant, seeing back. The tone of a man passing down not boasting—handing something over with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の知恵を集成して経営に活かされた
lines.en: Yes. He gathered the wisdom of his staff and wove it into how we ran things.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal. A son honoring his father's method. Steady breath. Each phrase deliberate, as if reciting something sacred but in his own words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、私有財産を会社に投じて創業されたぞ
lines.en: Your father risked his own savings to get the company off the ground.
lines.style: Weight in the voice now. Slower. A slight catch—the gravity of what it cost. Not dramatic, just honest about the stakes he took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の兼業に理解を示された
lines.en: Yes. He understood when people needed to work other jobs to survive.
lines.style: Gentle recognition. A younger man understanding what his father's kindness meant. Warm, almost tender. The realization settling as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、契約の満了前から次の手を打たれたぞ
lines.en: Your father made his next move before the contract even expired.
lines.style: Slight awe underneath. The voice of someone understanding foresight. Careful, almost reverent. A nod to strategic thinking that went unseen at the time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは古い顧客情報も丁寧に抹消された
lines.en: Yes. He even took care to erase the old customer records when we left.
lines.style: Quiet integrity in the words. A son recognizing his father's ethics—small acts that showed character. Thoughtful pause. The dignity of doing right by the next tenant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界協約を作る側に立たれたぞ
lines.en: Your father stood on the side that built industry standards, not just chased profit.
lines.style: Lift of conviction here. A voice that has grown into understanding what his father stood for. Clear, almost proud. The words carry the weight of legacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは家主との関係を大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He treated his relationship with his landlords as something that mattered.
lines.style: Close, warm, final. A son at peace with his inheritance. Slow, deliberate, grounded. The voice of someone who has learned what his father's care taught him. Gentle closure.
